_comment: CALIBRATION 2026-10-31 (see PROTOCOL.md): control arm only, N=3, on the private Attica corpus task attica-a3; the seed is off-tree and its digest is in the protocol. atomaRuns is 0 on purpose.

primary.goal: Fix one demonstrated admission-lock error path in browser/control-server.ts: POST /api/start acquires activeRun before scheduler.save(), but if that save throws the outer HTTP catch returns an error without releasing this request's lock. Keep the existing TypeScript implementation and CommonJS entry. Add a deterministic offline regression against the real createServer that injects exactly one scheduler.save failure after server setup, submits a valid fixture start, observes the error, restores saving, then completes real fixture collection on the SAME server. Prove the repaired second start is accepted and performs navigation/persists its expected row; a schedule-only response or a new server is not recovery proof. Preserve the lock of an already active collector when a competing request is refused. Fix only this request's ownership cleanup; do not broaden into startup checkpoint, store.mergeState/loadState or collector lifecycle changes in this iteration. Read tests/helpers/attica-control-harness.js and existing concurrency tests for actual supported interfaces. Use explicit temporary runtimeRoot/output/checkpoint/profile paths and a held/controlled loopback or fake browser session driving the actual collect-xe-browser.js collector. Keep existing regression tests/helpers, collector source, dependencies/lockfiles and historical data/evidence unchanged. Add a focused maintained TypeScript regression and run it plus root npm run check from a fresh copy with root npm ci, excluding all node_modules/dist/read-run and generated runtime/scratch directories. Keep strict checks and declaration lint coverage, no suppressions or any. Report actual failing-before/passing-after evidence and changed paths. No exhaustive unrelated HTTP/browser matrix or broader migration. Offline only, npm registry allowed; no real xe.gr/Spitogatos, external browser attachments, personal profiles, production data or hosting changes.
